question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Dwarf
solution:
The correct answer is **'Giant'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of **Dwarf:**
 
• **Dwarf - **a person, animal, or plant that is much smaller than the usual size.(बौना)
 
 
• Example - The skyscraper** dwarfs **all the other buildings around.
 
 
 
• **Giant -** an extremely large, strong person.(विशाल)
 
 
• Example - The **giant** pumpkin is also on its travels.
 
 

 After seeing the above explanation we can say that **'Giant'** is the opposite of** 'Dwarf'.**

** Hence, **the correct answer is** 'option 4'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

• **Medium - **in between two sizes, lengths, temperature, etc.(मध्यम)
 
• **Tiny - **very small.(बहुत छोटा)
